comment: docs/notes2: int4 PE 64x64 (4096 MACs). int4_wide's tile 1024x2048 breaks the A double buffering (tile_m/PM = 32 < 64 PEs: PEs 32-63 never get the next A values; PE 48x64 with the same tile gave wrong results and then hung), and missed 200 MHz by 0.215 ns. Tile 512x4096: tile_m/PM = 64 = PN, same per-PE C buffer (8x64 = 512 entries). 200 MHz aggressive and explore (one HLS run), 180 MHz default. DDR read taps tuned under load.
